name: Romila Thapar
shortBio: Preeminent Indian historian and historiographical philosopher who dismantled colonial Orientalist periodizations of ancient India by analyzing state formation, dissent traditions, and social-historical memory.
centralQuestion: How do colonial and nationalist historiographies invent monolithic religious pasts that obscure ancient India’s pluralist social transformations and heterodox dissent?

keyWorks.title: A History of India, Volume 1
keyWorks.description: Reoriented ancient Indian historiography from dynastic myth toward social, agrarian, and ideological formations.

keyWorks.title: The Past Before Us: Historical Traditions of Early North India
keyWorks.description: Refutes the Orientalist thesis that early India lacked historical consciousness, mapping embedded and externalized modes of historical reason.
